description: This file implements the GraphRewriter class functions for subgraph cleanup, buildup, and merging within the Torch JIT onednn fusion framework, involving graph node manipulation and subgraph management.

methods.name: cleanupSubgraphs
methods.description: Removes or unmerges subgraphs that are incomplete or invalid based on alias analysis.

methods.name: buildupSubgraphs
methods.description: Builds and merges subgraphs by iteratively scanning nodes and constructing subgraphs recursively.

methods.name: buildWorkBlocks
methods.description: Creates work blocks from the graph, segmenting nodes that can be reordered for subgraph merging.

methods.name: scanNode
methods.description: Scans a node within a work block to determine if it can be merged into a subgraph.

methods.name: tryMerge
methods.description: Attempts to merge a producer node into a consumer node's subgraph if conditions are met.
